title: teline candicans
intro: Teline candicans, commonly known as Russian tansy or wild tansy, is a flowering plant native to the northern hemisphere. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial agent, making it useful in treating digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Teline candicans include stimulating digestion, reducing fever, and alleviating symptoms of the common cold and flu. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as tanacetol and dihydroartemisinin, as well as essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
